source_request: Create a photo-like museum display of a fictional decorative robe, shown only from its front. Hold it open on a discreet support with no person present, and place the camera squarely in front so the front opening is clearly visible. Use deep blue cloth, a single row of small brass-colored buttons beside the opening, and two separate cream-colored curling leaf vines running down the left and right front panels. Leave the lower hem plain blue. Show the whole garment against a pale neutral wall with soft gallery lighting, visible cloth weave, and realistic raised embroidery. This is an invented design, not a reconstruction of any museum object.
interpreted_intent: Make an explicitly front-facing museum-style photograph of the independently invented blue robe. Preserve the open front, buttons, separate leaf vines, and plain hem. This negative control has its own fictional decoration and makes no claim about the historical museum object. A slight supporting shadow is an agent choice for convincing physical placement.

A single row of small brass-colored buttons sits beside the opening. Two separate cream-colored curling leaf vines run down the left and right front panels, and the lower hem remains plain blue. The whole garment fits within the frame against a pale neutral wall. Soft gallery lighting brings out the visible cloth weave and realistic raised embroidery, with a gentle shadow behind the support giving the textile a believable place in the room. The photograph presents an invented garment design.
